affected_subject.reason: Identifies TrailsIntentEntrypoint contract and its signature validation logic.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: a smart contract wallet user submits an off-chain signed intent/deposit.

direct_effect.reason: ECDSA.recover returns owner not wallet, recovered != user, causing revert and failed intents.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected EIP-1271 smart-wallet signature validation vs actual ECDSA-only validation, yielding authorization mismatch.

summary: Report fragments identify the affected contract, the smart-wallet signed-intent trigger, the revert/failed-intent effect, and the expected-vs-actual signature validation relation, so all four dimensions are present.
